name: AutomationDirect 70170-D control-device socket or base

summary: 70170-D control-device socket or base arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: 70170-D is the drawing identifier for control-device socket or base in AutomationDirect's Timers and Sockets collection. A socket or base provides the mounting and connection interface for a compatible control device. Its drawing does not identify every device that could physically appear to fit it.

For example, in a control panel where a plug-in device can be replaced without disturbing field wiring, use the 70170-D reference to coordinate socket terminals, retaining parts and plug-in removal route. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Relays and Timers/Timers and Sockets/70170-D.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep socket terminals, retaining parts and plug-in removal route visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named 70170-D drawing and its control-device socket or base role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
